#.label: Checkout App: Receipt
#.description: Split proposal B: by topic. Holds a sub-object per touchpoint: pos, sco, mpos. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-receipt-editor.

#/properties/pos.description: Staffed till: the desktop Checkout App in POS mode.
#/properties/pos/properties/receipt/prop: The duration for which the receipt remains visible after finalization. In milliseconds.
Defines whether voided items should be rendered on the Active Receipt.
This is a definition of the receipt layout settings.
The type of the identifier to be displayed in the receipt.

When true, the app displays the rounded amount due.
